in_hebrew.name: Karalynn
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Karalynn הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Karalynn is derived from the Greek word ‘Kara’, meaning ‘dear, beloved’, and the Old English word ‘Lynn’, meaning ‘stream’. This name was popular in the Middle Ages and was often given to girls who were born near a body of water.
